plan.name: OpenCode Go
notes: Each model has its own monthly dollar limit; its 5-hour window is 20% of it and its week 50%.
The plan-wide $12 per 5 hours, $30 per week and $60 per month windows come from the 2026-09-16 seed; the 2026-09-28 docs publish only the per-model limits.
Go Plus ($40/month) raises every model's monthly limit at the same token prices; this catalog tracks the $10 Go limits.
DeepSeek V4.x runs peak/off-peak pricing; peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri.
When a limit is reached you can keep using free models, or fall back to a Zen balance if enabled.

taskPresets.name: Everyday driver
taskPresets.description: Routine edits, feature work, agent loops where cost and throughput matter but quality must stay good.

taskPresets.name: Hard problem / architecture
taskPresets.description: Design work, gnarly refactors, debugging where a wrong answer costs more than tokens.

taskPresets.name: Bulk edits & test fixes
taskPresets.description: Mechanical changes across many files; volume beats brilliance.

taskPresets.name: Long-context work
taskPresets.description: Whole-repo reads, long transcripts, multi-file audits.

taskPresets.name: Vision / screenshots
taskPresets.description: Screenshot-driven UI work and image input; only models accepting image input qualify.

taskPresets.name: Quick chat / small asks
taskPresets.description: One-off questions, commit messages, tiny scripts.

glm-5.3-flash.verdict: Cheapest GLM on Go ($0.15/$0.50) with a $60 pool, ~6.3k requests per 5h. The 09-28 docs no longer mention a usage promo.
useFor: refactors you can verify with tests

glm-5.3.verdict: Top GLM tier on Go with a small $15 pool (~220 req/5h); save it for hard problems.

glm-5.2.verdict: GLM-5.3's price with a full $60 pool (~880 req/5h). Its AA index of 51 is below GLM-5.3 (60) and GLM-5.3-Flash (57).

glm-5.1.verdict: Dropped from the Go docs by Sep 28 but still on the roster; GLM-5.2 is the documented model at the same price.

kimi-k3.verdict: Frontier-tier Kimi (AA 57 at the seed date) with video input and 1M context, but only ~110 req/5h.

kimi-k2.7-code.verdict: Coding-tuned Kimi with a $60 pool and 262k output - a solid step above cheap flashes.

kimi-k2.6.verdict: Higher AA index than K2.7 Code and cheaper cached reads; the safer general Kimi pick.
avoidFor: anything you'd rather spend K3's tiny pool on

longcat-2.5-preview-free.verdict: Free and unlimited for a limited time (since Sep 25): Meituan's LongCat 2.5 preview with image input. No benchmark and no end date published.

longcat-2.0.verdict: Cache-read at $0.006/1M and 11.4k req/5h - built for very long cached sessions.
useFor: repetitive tasks with big cached context

mimo-v2.6-flash.verdict: Successor to MiMo-V2.5 (Sep 22) at the same price and ~30k req/5h pool, with text, image, audio and video input. No published benchmark yet.
avoidFor: work that needs a published quality index

mimo-v2.6-pro.verdict: Successor to MiMo-V2.5-Pro (Sep 22) at the same price and $15 pool (~16k req/month), with omni input. No published benchmark yet.
avoidFor: work that needs a published quality index

mimo-v2.5.verdict: Same price and ~30k req/5h pool as its successor MiMo-V2.6-Flash (Sep 22); keep it for sessions already tuned to it.

mimo-v2.5-pro.verdict: 42 AA index at flash prices on a $15 pool (~16k req/month); MiMo-V2.6-Pro (Sep 22) costs the same.

minimax-m3.verdict: Multimodal flagship with a strong 44 index and full $60 pool - the balanced pick.

minimax-m2.7.verdict: Slightly cheaper typical request than M3, lower quality - the budget MiniMax.

minimax-m2.5.verdict: Legacy MiniMax still served on the roster; pricing is identical to M2.7.

privacy.note: Contributor tier: prompts and completions are used to train Meta models. Region-limited (Meta Geographic Use Policy).

benchmarks: xhigh; max reasoning 62 in limited preview

muse-spark-1.3-contributor.verdict: Absurd value (~45k req/5h) but it trains on your prompts and is region-limited.

privacy.note: Contributor tier: prompts and completions train Meta models. Region-limited.

muse-spark-1.2-contributor.verdict: Previous Muse Spark at the same contributor terms; pick 1.3 unless you have a reason.

qwen3.8-max.verdict: New Qwen flagship - $15 pool and only ~810 requests per month; the scarcest pool on Go.

qwen3.8-flash.verdict: Go serves Qwen3.8-Flash-Next here: cheap multimodal workhorse with a 27k/month pool.
avoidFor: work that needs a published quality index

qwen3.7-max.verdict: Dropped from the Go docs by Sep 28 but still on the roster; prices here are from the 09-16 seed. Qwen3.8 Max is the documented Max.

qwen3.7-plus.verdict: 39 AA index with image+video input and 21.6k req/month - a dependable mid pick.

qwen3.6-plus.verdict: Dropped from the Go docs by Sep 28 but still on the roster; prices here are from the 09-16 seed. Qwen3.7 Plus is the documented Plus.

privacy.note: ZDR agreement renewed monthly; current term valid through 2026-10-31.

deepseek-v4.1-flash.verdict: The 09-28 docs list a $60 monthly pool (~26k req/5h) with no promo note; the 4x promo that ran until Sep 20 no longer appears.

privacy.note: ZDR agreement renewed monthly; current term valid through 2026-10-31.

benchmarks: requests route to V4.1-Flash (AA 40) since 2026-09-14 until V4.1-Pro

deepseek-v4-pro.verdict: 44 AA index historically, but requests have served V4.1-Flash (AA 40) since Sep 14, 2026 until V4.1-Pro launches.

privacy.note: ZDR agreement renewed monthly; current term valid through 2026-10-31.

benchmarks: id retired 2026-09-10; upstream routes to V4.1-Flash (AA 40)

deepseek-v4-flash.verdict: Retired upstream 2026-09-10 and served by V4.1-Flash; the id stays 13k req/5h with near-free cached reads.

privacy.note: Images are billed as input tokens by dimension.

benchmarks: id retired 2026-09-10; upstream routes to V4.1-Flash

deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp.verdict: Experimental vision id retired upstream; requests now route to V4.1-Flash (image input included).

hy4-preview.verdict: Preview of the next Hy with a mid-size pool; unproven until benchmarks exist.

hy3.verdict: 41 AA index at flash prices with a full $60 pool - quietly one of the best values.

union-alpha.verdict: Stealth model that was free for a limited time from Sep 16; gone from the roster and the docs by Sep 28.

space-bunny-free.verdict: Anonymous model, free and unlimited for a limited time (since Sep 23), with image and video input. Vendor, benchmarks and end date are unpublished.

privacy.note: ZDR would disable stateful Responses features; Go uses 30-day retention.

grok-4.7.verdict: Newest Grok on Go (Sep 21) at Grok 4.6's price and ~845 req/month pool, with PDF input added. No published benchmark yet.

privacy.note: ZDR would disable stateful Responses features; Go uses 30-day retention.

grok-4.6.verdict: Superseded by Grok 4.7 (Sep 21) at the same price and ~845 req/month pool; 30-day retention.

privacy.note: Abuse-monitoring logs retained up to 30 days.

gpt-6-luna.verdict: Newest OpenAI model on Go (Sep 22): half GPT 5.6 Luna's input price and about twice its requests from the same $15 pool. No published benchmark yet.
useFor: work you would have sent to GPT 5.6 Luna

privacy.note: Abuse-monitoring logs retained up to 30 days.

gpt-5.6-luna.verdict: Superseded by GPT 6 Luna (Sep 22), which halves the input price and gets about twice the requests from the same $15 pool.

kimi-k2.5.verdict: Legacy Kimi still on the roster (deprecated on the Zen side Aug 5, 2026).

glm-5.verdict: GLM-5 base, retained on the roster; GLM-5.2 is strictly newer.

deepseek-flash.verdict: Older DeepSeek Flash id served on the roster; metadata not published.

qwen3.5-plus.verdict: Previous-generation Qwen Plus; no AA data and not in the main list.

mimo-v2-pro.verdict: Live-roster model with no published docs row; no AA data.

mimo-v2-omni.verdict: Omni-input roster model: text+image+audio+video+pdf, no docs row yet.

hy3-preview.verdict: Hy3 preview iteration; AA index 34 from the seed snapshot.

grok-4.5.verdict: Older Grok still served; strong scores, but 4.7 is the current one.

omen-alpha.verdict: Stealth/named roster model with no docs row and no benchmark data.

ox-alpha-free.verdict: Older free/unlimited catalog entry, not on the roster; Space Bunny Free and LongCat 2.5 Preview Free are the current free models.

providerRoutes.note: Models Studio routes to outside OpenCode Go, rebuilt from models.dev into models.json providerModels. ids is the explicit list; keep models from the last 12 months plus the ids Studio's code names (pinned). provider supplies the metadata, priceProvider the list price, servedBy confirms the route serves the id.
